usedFor: Zite holds records, and “When a new record is created” can start “Create Document From Text” in Google Docs.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new record is created” in Zite, then “Create Document From Text” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: It creates a Google Doc with a title and content, optionally in a folder you choose.

watchOut: “When a new record is created” in Zite is polling, so the Google Doc appears after a short delay.
